---
title: "Figure 3A - Maternal vaccination-timing groups"
output: html_document
---

This notebook visualizes the gestational timing of maternal vaccine doses for
the five groups used in the two-month infant analysis. Run `01_load_data.Rmd`
first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))

stopifnot(exists("infant_meta_M2"))
```

## 1. Prepare dose timing data

```{r prepare-data}
group_descriptions <- c(
  "Group 1\nD1 and D2: <20 weeks",
  "Group 2\nD1: <20 weeks; D2: 20-28 weeks",
  "Group 3\nD1 and D2: 20-28 weeks",
  "Group 4\nD1: 20-28 weeks; D2: >28 weeks",
  "Group 5\nD1 and D2: >28 weeks"
)
names(group_descriptions) <- paste("Group", 1:5)

timing_data <- infant_meta_M2 %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group_descriptions[as.character(unique_groups)],
      levels = group_descriptions
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(GA_Vax1_days, GA_Vax2_days),
    names_to = "dose",
    values_to = "gestational_age_days"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dose = factor(
      dose,
      levels = c("GA_Vax2_days", "GA_Vax1_days"),
      labels = c("Dose 2 (D2)", "Dose 1 (D1)")
    )
  )
```

## 2. Plot vaccination timing

```{r plot-groups}
group_colors <- c("#669ccb", "#004488", "#eccc64", "#92414e", "#e69aa3")

figure_3a <- ggplot(
  timing_data,
  aes(gestational_age_days, dose, fill = group)
) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(20, 28) * 7, linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(x = "Gestational age (days) when dose was given", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(rep(1, 4), "cm")
  )
```

## 3. Save Figure 3A

```{r save-figure}
ggsave(
  output_path("Figure_3", "Figure_3A_vaccination_groups.png"),
  figure_3a,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 14.5,
  units = "in"
)
```
